verified: Names, descriptions and grades checked 2026-11-19 against Exophase (via planetgta6.com, 18 Nov) and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements; counts and methods checked against PowerPyx's trophy guide and roadmap (18 Nov) and GTABase (via egamers.io). Rockstar has not published an official list.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. The road is the story first, then the 100% checklist, then the long grinds: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, drone races at all 14 locations. PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and roughly 200 hours at a relaxed pace.
steps: Finish the story and every stranger strand
Reach 100% completion for A Long Road
Clean up the activity, robbery and collectible trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and the trophy unlocks automatically when the mission ends. No preparation is needed.
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. A story trophy: play the chapter's missions through to the end. Before the chapter closes, do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see the Missables tab) — it is the one thing in the game that can disappear.
steps: Play Chapter 1's missions to the end
Do Lucia's balcony meditation before the chapter ends

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. A story trophy. By now Jason and Lucia are playable together, which opens most of the side activities and partner robberies.
steps: Play Chapter 2's missions to the end

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. A story trophy. Watch for the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Yago's street-racing strand: it carries an hourglass icon, so save first and race the moment it appears — the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Save before the time-sensitive Race Against Yago and win it
Play Chapter 3's missions to the end

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last chapter before the finale. A story trophy. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay, so a fresh save per chapter is your safety net.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 4
Play the chapter's missions to the end

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. A story trophy and one of only two golds. Keep a manual save right before the final mission so you can return to free roam afterwards and mop up the open-world trophies.
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission
Finish the final mission

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. A story trophy: it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play the mission Breakfast Run to the end

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. A story trophy: it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play the mission The Cartel Heist to the end

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. A story trophy: it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play the mission Child's Play to the end

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. A story trophy: it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play the mission Headliners to the end

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. A story trophy: it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play the mission VCIA Takedown to the end

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy: it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory to the end

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The in-game checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once the story is done. PowerPyx's table splits it into story and tasks, exploration and activities, robberies, fencing totals, collectibles and scanning. The big asks: 70 of 80 Challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone time trials at 14 locations, 30 of 40 unique races, 15 of 18 meditation spots with both characters. It is the hardest trophy on the list.
steps: Finish the story to reveal the 100% checklist
Work the checklist section by section in free roam
Leave the hardest Challenges for last: only 70 of 80 are needed

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts are stunt jumps, under-bridge passes, knife flights and base jumps; the game counts 397 in total, and 100% wants 300, so the trophy comes first. Stunt jumps are the easiest to repeat — any fast vehicle and a good ramp will do.
steps: Do stunt jumps, bridge passes, knife flights and base jumps
Reach 250 stunts (300 counts toward 100%)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each activity type once. The tracker counts 9 types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities on the Touchpad menu to see which you have done.
steps: Open Progress > Activities to see the 9 types
Do each type at least once

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. That is 42 gold medals across 12 ranges — 18 at Griffin and 24 at Rodgers Ranch, per PowerPyx. The medals are not hard, just thorough: work through both ranges completely, one challenge at a time.
steps: Visit the Griffin range and gold its 18 challenges
Visit the Rodgers Ranch range and gold its 24 challenges

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 locations and 42 races in total (PowerPyx). One win per location is enough — you do not need to win every race.
steps: Find each of the 14 Top Fun drone race locations
Win at least one race at each location

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you only need half of them. Mix street races, race challenges and drone races; each distinct location counts once.
steps: Win races at 20 different locations
Mix street races, race challenges and drone races

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal, take his fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so it also counts toward Master of None.
steps: Find Cal and accept his fishing challenge
Win the challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade machine through to the end of a game. One of the quickest trophies on the list — do it early, whenever you pass an arcade.
steps: Find an arcade machine
Play a game through to the end

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is one of the stranger mission strands; play his missions through to the last one. It counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Play Andy's stranger missions to the last one

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern: run Kenton's stranger strand through to its last mission. It counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Play Kenton's stranger missions to the last one

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Billy. Run Billy's stranger strand through to its last mission. It counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Play Billy's stranger missions to the last one

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The strands belong to Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and other strangers — play each stranger's missions until their strand closes. Note the Chapter 3 Race Against Yago in Yago's street-racing strand: it is time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so save before it or the strand can stall.
steps: Find strangers across Leonida and start their strands
Save before the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Chapter 3
Close 8 strands in total

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Randy. Run Randy's stranger strand through to its last mission. It counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Play Randy's stranger missions to the last one

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission for Tyrone. Run Tyrone's stranger strand through to its last mission. It counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Play Tyrone's stranger missions to the last one

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations (PowerPyx); meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice, so bring your partner. THE ONE TO WATCH: the first meditation — Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house, the morning after the mission Down to Earth in Chapter 1 — disappears once Chapter 1 ends, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it. Do it anyway: in the morning, find Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and accept. Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops.
steps: In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth: follow Lucia to the balcony and meditate
Meditate at all 18 spots, with both characters where possible
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until the trophy pops

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's stranger strand sends you after one particular animal — follow his missions until the hunt itself. It counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Play Bret's stranger missions until the hunt
Take down the unique animal

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; finish three whole sets. Pick them up as you explore — they also feed the 100% checklist.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida
Complete 3 full sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK scans landmarks, sculptures and curiosities; the phone marks them as you pass. 100 scans sounds like a lot, but just scan everything you walk past and it adds up on its own.
steps: Open WAiNK at landmarks, sculptures and curiosities
Scan 100 locations in total

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges sit under Progress > Challenges: 8 categories of 10, 80 in total. Most complete on their own while you play. The trophy needs 50, while 100% needs 70, so leave the hardest ones for last.
steps: Check Progress > Challenges for the 8 categories
Complete 50 challenges (70 are needed for 100%)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner alongside, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Open country and water help; do not let your partner get caught while you hide.
steps: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner present
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Three shops in a row, partner present, and never lose the wanted level between them. Keep moving, do not stop to fight, and pick shops close together.
steps: Pick 3 shops close together
Rob them in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level the whole time

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive anything you have not driven before; the game logs each new vehicle. 100 is a fraction of what Leonida offers — vary your rides as you travel and it will come naturally.
steps: Drive a different vehicle whenever you can
Reach 100 distinct vehicles discovered

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies in front of you and drop 5 before it ends. A crowded shootout is the place to try it — wait for the enemies to bunch up first.
steps: Find a crowded shootout
Trigger Combat Focus and drop 5 enemies before it ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. The description points to the airport: leave Vice City International in a way that is not a scheduled flight — take a plane and go.
steps: Go to VCIA
Leave in a plane on an unscheduled departure

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description points at Rhino tanks: get into a confrontation involving one and come out on top.
steps: Find a Rhino tank
Survive the confrontation with it

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses spotting you. Plan the approach, keep out of sight lines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
steps: Scout the jewelry store first
Rob it without being seen or tripping an alarm

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five separate bank vault robberies, each ending in a clean escape. These open up in the later chapters — space them out and do not rush the getaway.
steps: Rob a bank vault and escape cleanly
Repeat for 5 vaults in total

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck on the road and get away with the cash. Ram or block it, grab the money, then lose the heat.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road
Stop it, take the cash and escape

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every area of the map — the in-game checklist tracks your coverage under exploration. Drive the full map in free roam and the trophy pops when the last area registers.
steps: Drive through every region of Leonida
Check the exploration checklist until the map is complete

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. One illegal operation per gang: find each gang's operation, rob it, and move on to the next gang's. They are spread across Leonida, so this pairs well with exploring the map.
steps: Find an illegal operation for each gang
Rob one operation per gang

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED: no guide source has established how this unlocks yet (PowerPyx, 18 Nov). The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — treat any how-to you find online as unverified until a second source confirms it.
steps: No confirmed method yet — check back once a guide confirms it

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description points to a vehicle showroom: drive out through it in style. PowerPyx marks the exact trigger as not yet known, so if it does not pop on the obvious attempt, do not grind it — check back once a guide confirms the moment.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom
Drive out through it in classic style

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish a game — follow-through on the lane. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so it also counts toward Master of None.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Play a game of bowling through to the end

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description points to a partner moment — play through the story moments with your partner and it should come naturally as the partnership builds.
steps: Play the story with your partner
Build the partnership through shared moments

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make choices as you play and the count builds over the story. It comes from simply playing and choosing — no farming is needed.
steps: Keep making choices as the story offers them

steps: No confirmed method yet — check back once a guide confirms it

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It also feeds the 100% checklist's fencing totals, so the robberies pull double duty.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food and gear — spending anywhere counts. It adds up naturally over a full playthrough; check your total under Progress if you are close.
steps: Spend money in shops as you play
Reach $100,000 spent in total

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the market. They also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good.
steps: Save up and buy each garage property
Own every garage

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register vehicles you own through the Scooter Bros app until you reach 10. Any vehicles count — use cheap ones you pick up while exploring.
steps: Own a vehicle
Register it in the Scooter Bros app — repeat until 10 are registered
